summary.text: Kyle Hansen is an independent candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windsor-4 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Michael Hoyt and Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party candidate Justin Schoville.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Pomfret resident with a professional background in planning and zoning.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Hansen graduated from Woodstock Union High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Norwich University in 2021 and a graduate degree from Vermont Law and Graduate School in 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

In his survey answers, he said he has been a member of Pomfret's Zoning Board of Adjustment since 2023, was recently appointed to fill a vacancy on the Pomfret Selectboard, and has volunteered since 2022 as a coach for Woodstock's fifth and sixth grade mountain bike team.

Hansen said in the survey that he is running for an affordable Vermont, and listed housing affordability, protections for workers and farmers, and local control for rural communities among his key messages.
His proposals include raising the income limit of the property tax credit and taxing second homes at the same rate as full-time residences.
